description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CreditScoring" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/creditscoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DelayNotice" name="Scoring delayed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FinalResult" name="Final scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Banking" name="Banking System" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Participant_Agency" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate result" sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="Catch_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Msg_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotice" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FinalResult" name="Final result" sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="Catch_FinalResult" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking System Credit Scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Banking">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BankingSystem" name="Banking System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ScoringRequested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendScoringRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ScoringResponse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_DelayNotice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_FinalResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ResultMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesClerk" name="Sales Clerk (Frontend)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShowCheckLater</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PresentResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ResultShown</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ScoringRequested" name="Credit scoring requested"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ScoringResponse" name="Agency response"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Msg_ImmediateResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DelayNotice" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShowCheckLater" name="Display message to check again later"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_FinalResult" name="Final result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FinalResult" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResultMerge" name="Result available"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PresentResult" name="Present scoring result to clerk"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ResultShown" name="Result shown at frontend"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_ScoringRequested" targetRef="Task_SendScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ScoringResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_ScoringResponse" targetRef="Catch_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_ScoringResponse" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Catch_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Gateway_ResultMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Catch_DelayNotice" targetRef="Task_ShowCheckLater"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ShowCheckLater" targetRef="Catch_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Catch_FinalResult" targetRef="Gateway_ResultMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_ResultMerge" targetRef="Task_PresentResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_PresentResult" targetRef="End_ResultShown"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
